dedupe_keys.name: global sand and gravel stocks and flows from 1900 to 2016

description: André Baumgart and Dominik Wiedenhofer at BOKU publish a global sand-and-gravel stock-flow synthesis. Zenodo provides an Excel workbook free under CC BY 4.0. It combines MAT_STOCKS/MISO2 estimates with UNEP resource-panel extraction and trade information, giving detailed 2016 flows and historical stock or flow series over 1900–2016. Categories distinguish aggregates awaiting asphalt or concrete manufacture from those already embedded in products. These quantities can calibrate material-demand and end-of-life scenarios for infrastructure construction. Related catalogue record data-mat-stocks-material-stocks-database covers the upstream stock model, but does not explicitly name this combined synthesis. Coverage is global aggregates, not surveyed local assets. Fixed binder-to-aggregate ratios and summarised process flows constrain interpretation; the estimates inherit model and source-data uncertainty. No workbook was downloaded, mass balance recalculated or national disaggregation inferred.
